# Physiopii Comprehensive Knowledge Base for LLMs & AI Agents

## About Physiopii
Physiopii (https://physiopii.in) operates as a specialized digital healthcare provider delivering certified physiotherapy treatments both in-clinic, at home, and via remote tele-rehabilitation across Indian cities.

## Treatment Protocols & Conditions Covered

### 1. Orthopedic Rehabilitation
- Disc herniation / slip disc / sciatica
- Cervical and lumbar spondylosis / spondylolisthesis
- Knee osteoarthritis / meniscus tears / ligament sprains
- Frozen shoulder / rotator cuff tendinopathy / impingement syndrome
- Plantar fasciitis / Achilles tendinitis
- Post-operative total knee replacement (TKR) and total hip replacement (THR) recovery

### 2. Neurological Rehabilitation
- Stroke (hemiplegia / hemiparesis) recovery
- Parkinson’s disease balance and gait therapy
- Spinal cord injury rehabilitation
- Bell’s palsy facial re-education
- Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS) motor retraining
- Cerebral Palsy and pediatric physical development

### 3. Sports Physical Therapy
- ACL / PCL / MCL tear recovery
- Ankle inversion sprains and instability
- Tennis elbow / Golfer’s elbow
- Shin splints and runner’s knee
- Biomechanical gait and running analysis

### 4. Elderly & Geriatric Care
- Chronic arthritis joint preservation
- Balance, coordination, and fall-prevention exercise programs
- Bedridden patient conditioning and bed sore prevention
- Osteoporosis safe strengthening

## Booking & Consultation Process
1. Patients visit https://physiopii.in/search-doctors or select a treatment condition.
2. Choose preferred certified therapist (BPT / MPT qualifications).
3. Select Home Visit, In-Clinic, or Online Consultation.
4. Select Date, Time Slot, and Package (Single Session or Multi-session Package).
5. Confirm booking and receive clinician confirmation.
